easyPrerequisites:
An opponent controls a creature.
If Kitsune is on the battlefield, it must not have summoning sickness and an opponent must be unable to block it.
description:
Cause Kitsune to enter or deal combat damage to a player, exchanging control of a creature an opponent controls and Altanak.
Cast Orcish Bowmasters by paying {1}{B}.
When Orcish Bowmasters enters, it triggers, targeting Altanak.
Altanak's second ability triggers, causing its controller to draw a card.
Orcish Bowmasters triggers, targeting Altanak.
Repeat from step 4 until the opponent loses the game due to drawing from an empty library.
